note: The superlative words lint C19 and C26 look for (CONTENT_GUIDE §2.13, §3.5). C19 warns when one appears in player-facing text with no high-risk claim behind it; C26 makes any claim holding one high-risk. The first seven are the words §2.13 names; the rest are the -est words and their kin. Matching is by whole word, case folded. Exempt everywhere: 'most of', which is a quantity. Exempt in C19 only: the standard comparison stems of §2.6 and 'only' before a number or 'a few'. The editor owns this list (§0.2).
